races.title: AIS Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: GLANCING JACK 's Newbury handicap debut second in March is strong form and he can make a successful reappearance for new trainer Dan Skelton. High Fibre 's excellent start for the James Owen yard includes a Summer Hurdle win at Market Rasen and a fourth in the Cesarewitch at Newmarket last month so he's an obvious threat. Keno Black has a similar profile to his yard's 2024 winner of this and is next on the list ahead of Norman Fletcher and unexposed Paul Nicholls handicap newcomer Outmaster . GLANCING JACK HIGH FIBRE (IRE) KENO BLACK (FR)

races.title: Mucking Brilliant Paddy Power Novices' Chase (Listed) (Registered As The Doctor Fothergill Novices' Chase) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Henry de Bromhead has already tasted success with a novice here this autumn and his KING'S BUCKS may well become another. He shaped well sent chasing after 6 months off when second at Galway 18 days ago and with the sharp test at this trip expected to hold no fears, he could be the answer. Intosomethinggood may emerge next best, ahead of Kingston Narcissus who has stamina to prove up in trip. KING'S BUCKS (FR) INTOSOMETHINGGOOD KINGSTON NARCISSUS (FR)

races.title: Shloer Chase (Registered As The Cheltenham Chase) (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A typically small field for this year's Shloer Chase and it's hard to get away from JONBON , who bids for a third success in the race and had bottomless ground as an excuse for his below-par second last year. Fragility remains an ongoing problem for Gidleigh Park , but he can provide most resistance if returning on his A-game, with the race-fit Saint Segal taken to fill out third. JONBON (FR) GIDLEIGH PARK SAINT SEGAL (FR)
races.bettingForecast: Jonbon (1/2), Gidleigh Park (3/1), Mighty Bandit (7/2), Saint Segal (9/2)

races.title: Jilly Cooper Veterans' Handicap Chase
races.verdict: TRIPLE TRADE won at this meeting last year and is building up a good record in these events, so appeals as the most solid option with his yard still thriving. Mahons Glory and Thunder Rock head the dangers. TRIPLE TRADE MAHONS GLORY (IRE) THUNDER ROCK (IRE)

races.title: Albert Bartlett Novices' Hurdle (Grade 2) (Registered As The Hyde) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: DIVINE DIVA was back to looking much more the bright prospect she'd appeared when placed in a listed bumper at this meeting last year when scoring in good style on her recent hurdling debut at Chepstow and it looks significant Harry Skelton has chosen her over Hitintheheadlines , who accounted for 4 next-time-out winners on his first go over hurdles at the aforementioned venue. Ferocimo cruised clear in the manner of an above-average novice at Fontwell and is a very interesting contender, too. DIVINE DIVA (IRE) HITINTHEHEADLINES (IRE) FEROCIMO (IRE)

races.title: Valda Energy Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: WAY OF STARS looks to have plenty in his favour in a stacked renewal, and he may well gain compensation for his Chepstow near miss. The main danger could be handicap debutant Lexington Wood , who has plenty of untapped potential, while Dan Skelton's Sytadel is another who is probably well treated. Eben Zaabeel is potentially most interesting of a healthy Irish contingent, his shrewd connections landing a touch in this corresponding race back in 2013. WAY OF STARS (IRE) LEXINGTON WOOD (FR) SYTADEL (FR)
